noDrive.title: No USB drive
noDrive.body: Plug a USB drive into the TV to play its videos here.

unreadable.title: This folder can't be read
unreadable.body: The drive may have been pulled out.

empty.title: Nothing to play here
empty.body: This folder has no videos or folders in it.

playback.stuck: This TV doesn't play this file: its picture never started. With no server to convert it, try another copy.
playback.cantConvert: This TV can't play this file as it is, and a file on a drive has no server to convert it
